steps.step: Sign-in asks for email and password; no development sign-in is offered
Sign-up asks the person to confirm their email address
Signing in before confirming is refused with a clear message
Signed in: the provider's tokens are in an HTTP-only cookie
Inviting without the second step is refused and points to it
Authenticator setup shows a QR code and a key
With the right code the session is upgraded and the invitation is created
Signed out: protected pages send you to sign-in
Next time, only the 6-digit code is asked for
Tokens are refreshed before they expire and the person stays signed in
When the provider ends the session (e.g. signed out everywhere), the app signs the person out
